result.title: Illusion of Explainability: A Sanity Check for Spectral Band Attribution in Satellite Time-Series Crop Classification
result.comment: Accepted at the 4th Computer Vision for Earth Observation (CV4EO) Workshop at WACV 2027
result.summary: Attribution methods are commonly validated through convergence across methods and consistency with domain knowledge, yet neither criterion establishes whether identified features are necessary for a task. This limitation is particularly relevant in multispectral remote sensing, where overlapping spectral information makes individual bands potentially substitutable. We investigate this gap in crop-type classification using GradientSHAP, Shapley sampling, and Occlusion on a U-TAE segmentation model trained on Sentinel-2 time series from the PASTIS benchmark. All three methods identify vegetation-sensitive spectral regions consistent with domain knowledge, while Shapley and Occlusion exhibit strong ordering sensitivity in deletion and insertion tests. However, these properties do not reliably predict retraining performance. Aggregate attribution consensus masks substantial per-class disagreement, with pairwise mean Spearman correlations ranging from 0.09 to 0.79. Models retrained from scratch using the five lowest-ranked bands perform comparably to or better than those using the five highest-ranked bands. Furthermore, attribution rankings from an independently trained model with identical configuration and seed identify a different top-five subset that yields better retraining performance. Analysis of all 252 five-band subsets reveals consistently low effective dimensionality (1.35 to 2.62), suggesting substantial spectral redundancy. These findings demonstrate that plausible and apparently faithful attribution rankings do not necessarily identify task-relevant bands for improved retrained performance, highlighting the limitations of band-level feature attribution in spectrally redundant input spaces.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文以 Sentinel-2 时序作物分类为任务，检验 GradientSHAP、Shapley 采样与 Occlusion 的波段归因是否真正反映任务必要性：发现三种方法虽与领域知识一致，但归因排名无法预测重训练结果，用最低排名波段重训练甚至不劣于最高排名波段，且全子集分析显示有效维度很低、谱段高度冗余。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以重训练必要性而非归因一致性判定特征使用」的检验思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉 token 或特征是否被答案实际使用、贡献分配与视觉旁路问题；但领域相隔较远，与 latent 状态生成无直接联系，需人工判断迁移可行性。
